title: ALL-NEW 2026 QUICK PRO UR:ONE - The lowdown.

takeaways.text: Launch-day look (January 2026), not ridden. Repeats Quick Pro's claims: 629 g bare size-M frame, 339 g fork, 115 g seatpost, about 100 g lighter than the AR:ONE, ceramic headset bearings and titanium bolts.
The China price was said to equal about US$2,700, roughly 25% more than the AR:ONE; overseas pricing was not final. The presenter's store sells Quick Pro.
Geometry adds stack across sizes and more bottom-bracket drop than the AR:ONE; adds an XXS size. Clearance stays 32 mm, with UDH and a BSA bottom bracket.

disclosure: China Cycling's founder also leads Panda Podium, a retailer of Chinese cycling products.
summary: First look at the named 2026 UR:ONE platform, retained as a lead until its category, production specification, China route, and current RMB price are proven.
